notes: This is a Mo Willems early reader book focused on a cat who introduces her animal friends one by one. The core vocabulary of the book is highly repetitive around meeting and greeting. Key fringe words reflect the four animal characters (cat, fish, duck, mouse), the social greeting theme (hello, meet, wave), and emotional/descriptive words (smile, happy, friend, new). The word 'new' is used in the book's refrain when Cat introduces someone new. Duck is flagged as ambiguous. The hero image must be sourced as Cat the Cat is a distinctive Mo Willems character not well represented in generic Boardmaker libraries.
